mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes of high consumer spending growth (RSAFS growth > 2% annually) and expanding housing market (HOUST > 1350 thousand units), elevated corporate revenue expectations drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 2%) and expanding housing market (HOUST > 1350)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or RSAFS Rank IC in the regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or INDPRO Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for three consecutive months, tight labor market conditions increase wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or UNRATE Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST growth fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually), the Federal Reserve's likely policy tightening increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or CPIAUCSL Rank IC in high inflation regimes is below 0.03.
